independence: Independent review of unchanged en/zh-CN/es pages. The reviewer authored none of these pages. Decisions below were written after reading the fresh prefix browser text, copied programs, HTTP Markdown responses, and the retained execution inputs and outputs.
scope: All artifact routes are hash-bound for freshness; binding is not a claim of manual reading of every page. Actual readUrls, raw observations, task answers and evidence below define the review scope.
executionReuse: No SDK consumer was rerun for this baseline maintenance. Current source/dependency equality, exact clipboard programs, previous actual installation/execution logs and independent ZIP/Zstandard/SQLite inspection of ten retained APKGs justify explicitly bound reuse. New browser navigation, clipboard and recipe downloads occurred for every locale/configuration.
visualInspection: Reviewer inspected prefix screenshots en/rust-basic, zh-CN/python-basic and es/node-basic at 1440x1000. Other screenshots record browser state; no claim that every screenshot was manually inspected.
